verdict.rationale: SumUp offers an official JavaScript SDK (@sumup/sdk) with TypeScript declarations, alongside a documented Agent Toolkit that adds SumUp API tools to LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and MCP, plus a managed MCP server for AI clients — directly enabling AI-native developers to build against official SDKs and agentic tooling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the SDK's completeness and broader multi-language SDK coverage beyond JavaScript.
